summary: A city creates a civilian police oversight board and its first year shows hundreds of complaints, few closed cases and slow records from police.
realLife: Rochester's Police Accountability Board took complaints from June 2022; its first annual report counted 360 reports and 77 closed cases, most outside its reach, with cases averaging nearly 200 days against a 90-day goal and only two of 137 information requests fully answered. Later the police union sued, and in April 2025 a judge barred the board from investigating or publishing reports; the city appealed.
